fields.Name: R2p -> S4.3
fields.Description: Gate G2.16 (phase 2, dataset R2p, criterion S4.3): on R2p a non-negative target ranks and gates on Tweedie deviance at its declared power 1.5; the GLM baseline's holdout deviance and the XGBoost candidate's inner-CV deviance each equal the reference pipeline's Tweedie fits within 1e-6, and what the gate ships scores at most 22.7529 on the 6,250 held-out rows, with 0 negative predictions, 1 of 1. It fails when the Tweedie objective falls back to squared error for the boosted candidates (the XGBoost candidate's inner deviance departs from the reference pipeline's) or for the Tweedie GLM baseline (the GLM baseline's deviance departs from the reference pipeline's).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Tweedie deviance (power 1.5) is the primary score on R2p; the GLM baseline and the XGBoost candidate match the reference pipeline's Tweedie fits and the shipped model scores at most 22.7529 with no negative values (1 of 1 pytest case passes).
